shared_hypothesis: A learned router placed at reproducible high-conflict FFNs will separate from frozen-routing and equal-total-parameter dense controls more than the same intervention at a low-conflict placebo.
predicted_signature: At blocks 11 or 10+11, learned routing keeps noncollapsed expert use and improves paired OOD-validation or tail ordering by epoch 5; the effect is absent or smaller at block 1.
alternative_explanation: Any difference is ordinary parameter capacity, initialization, or seed noise rather than conditional computation.
falsifier: Learned routing fails to beat both controls at high-conflict placements, collapses, or shows the same advantage at the low-conflict placebo.
checkpoint_policy: save epochs 2 and 5 plus result, milestones, train log, config, and manifest
result_budget: epoch 5 only; continue a small family-leading fraction to epoch 10 only after strict paired and mechanism validation
multiplicity: Exploratory seed-0 localization, intervention-depth, router-state, and horizon screen; any winner requires locked hyperparameters and fresh seeds.
